subject.title: fix(agent): recover disconnected gateway runs before rerunning

question: Should `openclaw agent` adopt bounded reattach-first recovery after an accepted Gateway disconnect, and what exact behavior should apply when recovery is exhausted or remains ambiguous?
rationale: This is a deliberate CLI compatibility and UX policy choice—authoritative-result recovery, wait time, error propagation, and automatic fallback semantics—not a mechanical correction that the contributor or automation can safely choose alone.

options.title: Sponsor bounded recovery first
options.body: Adopt the branch's reattach-first attempt with a documented finite recovery deadline, then retain the current isolated embedded fallback after exhaustion.

options.title: Keep recook-first containment
options.body: Retain the existing immediate fresh-session fallback and close or narrow the recovery-first portion if preserving prompt CLI output is preferred.

options.title: Split delivery behavior
options.body: Use recovery-first only for a narrowly defined mode such as `--deliver`, leaving interactive stdout behavior on the current fallback contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor bounded recovery first
recommendation.body: Adopt the branch's reattach-first attempt with a documented finite recovery deadline, then retain the current isolated embedded fallback after exhaustion.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current merged abnormal-close/fresh-session fallback behavior that this PR would supersede on the affected path.
